issue_context.title: CTB - Modal retains previous tab status
issue_context.body:
## Bug report

### Required System information

Node.js version: 20.9.0
Strapi version: 5.0.0-beta.13
Operating system: Windows WSL and OS

### Describe the bug

when you were on an Advanced settings tab when validating a new field creation, then for the next field creation, you arrive directly on Advanced settings tab instead of Basic settings tab (shouldn't be the case)

### Steps to reproduce the behavior

1. Go to CTB
2. Create a new CT
3. Create your first field, go to Advanced settings tab, validate
4. Create your second field : you're directly on Advanced settings tab instead of Basic settings tab

### Expected behavior

For every field creation, user should first arrive on Basic settings tab.

### Screenshots

https://app.dashcam.io/replay/6673edb810c6b5007053a42d?share=sGQ8Fg1JoBHunuehwMh9Gw

review_comments: I think it's only at this point `onNavigateToChooseAttributeModal` that we need to ensure activeTab is reset to 'basic'?

I prefered to always reset it just in case (thinking about when you cancel or go back a step what happens) 
but happy to change if you think it's unnecessary
